title: 3D HD Versus 2D HD in Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare 3D-laparoscopy versus 2D-laparoscopy with the use of HD resolution in cholecystectomy in terms of error rating, performance time and subjective assessment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients scheduled for elective cholecystectomy (out-patient treatment)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous upper abdominal surgery
* ASA-score 3 or above
